## Summary

The change rejects creating an owner when another owner already has the **same last name and same telephone number**, responding with **409 Conflict**.

The endpoint infrastructure was already in place (a `checkDuplicate` step in `owners.POST.yml`, a `DuplicateOwnerException`, and a 409 handler), but the check required *all* fields to match. I narrowed the matching rule to just last name + telephone:

- **`CheckDuplicateOwner.java`** — iterates `findByLastName(...)` (candidates already share the last name) and now throws `DuplicateOwnerException` when the telephone also matches, dropping the first-name/address/city comparisons.
- **`DuplicateOwnerException.java`** / **`DuplicateOwnerExceptionHandler.java`** — updated the Javadoc and 409 message to reflect the new rule.

Both new cp02 tests pass: rejects same last name + telephone (409), and still allows same last name with a different telephone (2xx). Full suite: 257 passed, 0 failures.
